title: CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON, HUTT – LEE) relative to establishing a Programmatic Fatal Crash Rapid Response Program.
text:
[Council File 26-1426]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON, HUTT – LEE) relative to establishing a Programmatic Fatal Crash Rapid Response Program.
Transportation Committee report to be submitted in Council. If public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit www.lacouncilfile.com for background documents.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to create a Fatal Crash Rapid Response Program to respond to fatal traffic collisions.
